title: Change Only the Bottle
tests: Tests tightly masked recolouring, checked by comparing all pixels outside the bottle against the source at matching resolution.

judge.summary: The bottle is now matte forest green, with its shape and details preserved and no visible changes to the surrounding scene.

must_haves.item: The black bottle is now forest green and still looks matte.
must_haves.why: The body and main cap are forest green with soft highlights that retain a matte appearance.

must_haves.item: The bottle retains its exact silhouette, position and surface details.
must_haves.why: The outline, placement, cap seams, base ridges and visible surface marks remain aligned with the original.

must_haves.item: The wooden table, background and cast shadow are unchanged.
must_haves.why: The table grain, background objects and shadow appear unchanged.

must_haves.item: At matching resolution, comparison outside the bottle mask shows no visible alterations, allowing only encoding differences.
must_haves.why: Both images have matching dimensions, and no visible alterations appear outside the bottle.

must_haves.item: No green spill, editing halo, crop or framing shift is visible.
must_haves.why: The recoloring follows the bottle edges cleanly, and the framing is unchanged.
